title: Geekvape Supermesh Replacement Coils
description:
Description
Specifications
Note: Sold individually. Please adjust the quantity to the desired number prior to ordering.
Replacement coils for the Geek Vape Cerberus Tank, Geek Vape Shield Tank, Aero Tank, Aero Mesh Tank, TFV8 Baby series tanks, TFV12 Baby Price Tank.
Consistently brings delicious flavour and balanced heat distribution for every drop. These coils are designed to be used with freebase e-liquid.
Available in:
X1 0.2ohm, 30-90W
X2 0.4ohm, 30-45W
